properties.name: flex_direction
properties.comment: flex-direction: row, row-reverse, column or column-reverse (else std::invalid_argument).
prepare: if (incoming > FlexDirection::column_reverse) throw std::invalid_argument("FlexPanel flex direction is unknown");

properties.name: flex_wrap
properties.comment: flex-wrap: nowrap, wrap or wrap-reverse (else std::invalid_argument).
prepare: if (incoming > FlexWrap::wrap_reverse) throw std::invalid_argument("FlexPanel flex wrap is unknown");

properties.name: justify_content
properties.comment: justify-content: normal, stretch (as flex-start), start, end, flex-start, flex-end, center and the three space distributions (else std::invalid_argument).
prepare: if (!admitted_content_alignment(incoming) || incoming > LayoutAlignment::space_evenly) throw std::invalid_argument("FlexPanel justify-content admits no such value");

properties.name: align_content
properties.comment: align-content: the justify-content values; normal and stretch stretch the lines (else std::invalid_argument).
prepare: if (!admitted_content_alignment(incoming) || incoming > LayoutAlignment::space_evenly) throw std::invalid_argument("FlexPanel align-content admits no such value");

properties.name: align_items
properties.comment: align-items: normal and stretch stretch the items; start, end, flex-start, flex-end, center and baseline (else std::invalid_argument).
prepare: if (!admitted_items_alignment(incoming)) throw std::invalid_argument("FlexPanel align-items admits no such value");

properties.name: row_gap
properties.comment: row-gap; a percentage is of the content box's height, and zero when that is indefinite. Finite and nonnegative (else std::invalid_argument).
prepare: if (!admitted_gap(incoming)) throw std::invalid_argument("FlexPanel row gap must be finite and nonnegative");

properties.name: column_gap
properties.comment: column-gap; a percentage is of the content box's width, and zero when that is indefinite. Finite and nonnegative (else std::invalid_argument).
prepare: if (!admitted_gap(incoming)) throw std::invalid_argument("FlexPanel column gap must be finite and nonnegative");
